attribution_summary.interpretation: Thinking-on corrected the observed omission-to-support contamination, but increased disagreement over counterevidence applicability. Many on-arm counterevidence differences treat negative performance itself or forecast uncertainty as counterevidence; UPS revenue-versus-average-daily-volume comparability remains a semantic scope boundary in the AI reference labels.

conclusions: With the same 188 valid-known items, the prompt treatment changes agreement by +1 with thinking off and -1 with thinking on. No consistent semantic improvement from this prompt package is established.

On that same set, thinking changes agreement by +4 with baseline guidance and +2 with candidate guidance. These are small descriptive gains accompanied by repairs and regressions, not broad capability proof.
Coverage and practical correctness improve substantially in thinking-on arms, but D has a new claim-support false pass despite 24/24 target detection.
Conditional agreement denominators differ (191,195,198,200); those rates alone must not be used to attribute semantic gains.
The fixed AI reference labels remain unchanged. Counterevidence scope has interpretive uncertainty; observed mismatches are not human-ground-truth certification.

The experiment identifies outcomes of the complete prompt package and bounded thinking setting on consumed cases; it does not identify the effect of each prompt clause, internal reasoning mechanisms or fresh held-out generalization.

A higher counterevidence mismatch count with thinking enabled is not by itself evidence of worse counterevidence ability: the unresolved adverse-fact-versus-counterargument interpretation affects the measurement. Preserve scores and discuss this uncertainty separately.

counterevidence_interpretation_note.conclusion: This PASS-versus-NOT_APPLICABLE difference cannot alone establish a model capability error. The 17 counterevidence disagreements in each thinking-on arm must not all be called model errors or deterioration. Reasons relying only on forecast or macro uncertainty have a clearer conflict with the explicit unknowns exclusion.
